description: Generated REST client for the Bonder API, with a token-renewing HTTP handler. Used by Bonder integrations and on-premise sync agents.
releaseNotes:
1.3.1 — regenerated from the current master API; 

MFA:

* TokenResult gains MfaRequired, MfaChallengeToken, MfaSetupRequired,
  MfaMethods and MfaSetupMethods. When MfaRequired is true, Token is empty:
  finish the login with VerifyMfaAsync (or SendMfaCodeAsync first for mail/SMS
  codes) using MfaChallengeToken.
* A password, mail-code or SMS-code login of a user with required MFA fails
  with MFA_APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED unless the request carries the header
  X-Bonder-Mfa: 1 (set it on the HttpClient's DefaultRequestHeaders).

BREAKING:

* Removed: ConvertSupportCaseToKnowledgeEntryAsync,
  CreateChecklistExecutionForTestingAsync,
  GetAllowedChecklistCategoriesForSupportCaseAsync, and the DTOs
  ConvertToKnowledgeEntryResponseDto and DuplicateKnowledgeEntryDto.
* StateGroupDto loses ChecklistCategoryIds, FeedbackChecklist and
  FeedbackChecklistId.
* LicenseCountsDto.Backoffice, FieldService and Partner are now int?.
* CreateTenantAuthenticationsAsync gains subtype and the mfa* switches;
  GetSupportEmbedTemplatesAsync gains bool? includeDefault.

Unchanged from 1.3.0: SendMailAsync(tenantId, mailServerId, bool? synchronous,
body). Pass null (or false) to queue the mail as 1.2.9 did.

ADDED (93 routes, all methods named <OperationId>Async):

* MFA login (1/me/mfa): GetMfaStatus, VerifyMfa, SendMfaCode,
  StartMfaSetupForLogin, ConfirmMfaSetupForLogin, StartMfaPasskey,
  VerifyMfaPasskey, StartMfaPasskeySetupForLogin,
  CompleteMfaPasskeySetupForLogin.
* Own second factor: StartMfaSetup, ConfirmMfaSetup, DisableMfa, StepUpMfa,
  StartStepUpPasskey, StepUpWithPasskey; admins: ResetUserMfa.
* Passkeys (1/me/passkey*): StartPasskeyLogin, LoginWithPasskey, GetPasskeys,
  StartPasskeyRegistration, RegisterPasskey, RenamePasskey, RemovePasskey.
* Tenant domains (1/tenants/{tenantId}/domains): GetTenantDomains,
  AddTenantDomain, RemoveTenantDomain, CheckTenantDomain,
  GetTenantFreeDomainSuffix, SetTenantPrimaryDomain,
  SetTenantDomainCertificate, ValidateTenantDomainCertificate.
* Licences: GetLicenseStock, GetTenantSubscriptions.
* On-prem agents and the BonderSync Manager (1/TenantIntegrations/{id}/agent):
  GetIntegrationAgent, GetIntegrationAgentKey, GetIntegrationAgentTarget,
  SetIntegrationAgentTarget, RegisterIntegrationAgentRelease,
  GetIntegrationAgentFile, UploadIntegrationAgentFile, ReportIntegrationAgent,
  GetIntegrationManagerTarget, SetIntegrationManagerTarget,
  RegisterIntegrationManagerRelease.
* Scheduled on-prem file import (1/TenantIntegrations/{id}/onprem-files):
  PlanOnPremScheduledImport, UploadOnPremScheduledImportFile,
  CompleteOnPremScheduledImport.
* Parked integration events: ParkIntegrationEvents,
  GetIntegrationParkedEvents, AckIntegrationParkedEvents.
* Jira import: PreviewJiraImportScope, RunJiraImport, GetJiraImportUsers.
* Knowledge review on assets (1/assets/{id}/knowledge): GetKnowledgeReview,
  ValidateKnowledge, ApproveKnowledge, RejectKnowledge,
  AnswerKnowledgeQuestions, ImportKnowledgeDocument, GetKnowledgeImages,
  UploadKnowledgeImage, DeleteKnowledgeImage, AdoptKnowledgeDraftImages;
  drafts: UploadKnowledgeDraftImage, ImportKnowledgeDraftDocument;
  StartKnowledgeBackfill.
* Support cases: GetSupportCaseKnowledge, HarvestSupportCaseKnowledge,
  GetAiFeedback, SetAiFeedback, DeleteAiFeedback,
  ResolveSupportCaseMailContact.
* Checklists: CreateStandaloneChecklistExecution,
  CreateDefaultSupportChecklistExecution, GetStateGroupDefaultChecklistIds,
  FilterChecklistsAllowedForSupportCase (replaces
  GetAllowedChecklistCategoriesForSupportCase), GetChecklistExecutionPdf,
  GetChecklistReportTemplate.
* Dashboards: CloneDashboard, HideDashboard, ResetDashboardToTemplate,
  GetDashboardSharing, SetDashboardSharing.
* Assets: SetAssetState. Custom data: RevealCustomData.
* Users: CountMissingLocations, GeocodeMissingLocations.
* Communications: GetBonderCommunications, CanPublishGlobally.
* AI search chat: SetAiChatFeedback, DeleteAiChatFeedback.
* Deployment: FreezeDeploys, ReleaseDeployFreeze.

1.3.0 — first regeneration since 1.2.9 (May 2025). 76 commits of API surface;
the public type count goes from 293 to 502 and BonderClient gains 637 methods.

BREAKING — read before upgrading:

* Update2Async now targets a different endpoint. In 1.2.9 it updated a support
  case; it now updates an ErrorClusterExecution. Support-case update moved to
  UpdateSupportCaseAsync(Guid, SupportCaseUpdateDto). NSwag renumbers the
  UpdateNAsync overloads whenever routes are added, so prefer the named
  methods (UpdateSupportCaseAsync, UpdateSupportCaseWithDefaultsAsync) over
  UpdateNAsync, which will keep shifting between releases.
* Support-activity CRUD is gone: CreateSupportActivityAsync,
  UpdateSupportActivityAsync, DeleteSupportActivityAsync and
  GetSupportActivityAsync no longer exist. Use GetSupportActivitiesAsync /
  GetAllSupportActivitiesAsync, plus the SupportActivityFile methods.
* The generated VerticalCodes.Bonder.NetClient.TimeSpan DTO is removed.
  ActionDto.TemplateDuration is now a string, and Extensions.RetryActionAsync
  takes a System.TimeSpan.
* CreateBonderClient takes a fifth Guid parameter.
* Nullability: CreateProductDto.ProductCatalog and UpdateProductDto.ProductCatalog
  are now bool? (the server defaults them when omitted), and
  SupportActivityDto.SupportCaseId / SupportActivityCommandDto.SupportCaseId are
  now Guid?. Both DTOs also gain SupportByPartner.
* Removed members: SupportCaseWorkReportDto.AttachFinalizationChecklist,
  SupportMessageDto.Viewers, UserDto.ViewedSupportMessages.
* Changed signatures: SendMailAsync takes an extra bool?, VerifyInviteAsync
  returns bool instead of TenantDto, GetUserHeaderImageAsync takes a string,
  UpdateChecklistExecutionAsync returns ChecklistExecutionDto, and
  GetAnalysisAsync and CreateTenantAuthenticationsAsync were re-signatured.

ADDED:

* RetryAuthenticatedHttpClientHandler takes a Func<bool, Task<string>> so the
  token callback can be asked to force a full re-login instead of a renewal,
  and exposes TraceLog and FailureLog hooks for opt-in per-request diagnostics.
* New API areas: saved filters and filter preview/validation, communications,
  action confirmations, bonus points, appointment auto-planning, activity
  templates, appointments and calendars, background jobs, API keys, MCP
  clients, AI suggestions and chat history, and change-log/changes-since.

Package metadata now carries real authors and a description; 1.2.9 shipped
with NSwag placeholders.
